correctness.rationale: For the explicitly specified eleven-vertex twenty-edge Mycielski graph the generating polynomial identity is exact term by term: it counts five cycle edges and each independent shadow vertex factor covers three incident edges. The two independent exact-integer programs evaluate all 177147 assignments via direct enumeration versus a 729-case six-spin elimination, and agree on every (occupancy,frustration) coefficient. They establish the exact twelve-sector table and all seven rational crossing degeneracies; no finite evidence is extrapolated to a larger family.

value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the smallest triangle-free four-chromatic network, so three spin labels impose global frustration without triangular plaquettes. The exact field response has eight natural occupancy plateaux, seven coexistence fields, a four-sector zero-field coexistence with 660 labeled configurations, and three symmetry-distinct frustrated-edge orbit counts. This supplies a motivated finite-spin benchmark and a complete natural invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice. No thermodynamic-limit claim is made.
